### big buffers? (in 2011 or so) 


![](/congest-opt/cacm-bufferbloat-fig5){}
 [ Jim Gettys and Kathleen Nichols, <br> ‘‘Bufferbloat: Dark Buffers in the Internet’’ (CACM, Jan 2012)]{.my-small}

### problems with big buffers 


* high latency --- bad for some applications
* slower response to congestion 

   * 1 second round trip time = 1 second to detect congestion
   * more likely to have ‘congestion collapse’



### avoiding big buffers  {.smaller}


* multiple fixes (that can be combined): 
<hr class="vspace" />
* use smaller buffers? 

   * simpliest solution

* detect congestion without full buffer…  

   * [by choosing when/which packets to drop better?]{.fragment fragment-index=3 .custom .myem-only}
   * [by using something other than drops?]{.fragment fragment-index=4 .custom .myem-only}
